rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: ClawdPay enables AI agents to make real purchases using Privacy.com virtual cards through intelligent browser automation. The server creates single-use virtual cards with spending limits, then uses Playwright to automatically detect and fill payment forms across websites using robust field-matching heuristics that identify card number, CVV, and expiration date fields through multiple strategies including labels, placeholders, and autocomplete attributes. Built for secure AI-powered commerce, it supports both sandbox testing and production environments, making it particularly valuable for autonomous purchasing workflows, e-commerce testing, and AI agents that need to complete transactions while maintaining financial security through disposable card numbers.
